analysis: Paired probe-label counts/probability differences and input token deltas. No classification accuracy, semantic correctness score, layer/threshold search or new behavior score. Report question changes separately within each document level; document bundle O-to-P is not a pure style/length contrast; P-to-N deletions still change length.
endpoint_exposure: Original O/O and previous A/P endpoint features and aggregate predictions were inspected before design. All ten exposed bases retained; the six N bases are fixed solely by presence of the six specified redundant negative clauses, not selected by future results.
scope_limit: Clarified questions sometimes narrow scope; original and authored document bundles differ in facts, distractors and order. No same-semantics claim for O-to-P or O-to-A. N preserves explicit positive answer-bearing propositions under the authored scope, not every possible open-world entailment. Development diagnostic, not independent gold/confirmation or a causal hidden-state intervention.
